stories.title: Judge orders return of alleged trafficking victim sent to France under 'one in one out' scheme
stories.summary: A judge has ordered the return of a person alleged to be a trafficking victim who was removed to France under the UK-France 'one in one out' migrant returns scheme, raising questions about the scheme's safeguards.

stories.title: France hits out at Reform UK plan to use Navy to return migrants
stories.summary: France has criticised a Reform UK proposal to use the Royal Navy to force small boats carrying migrants back across the Channel, saying it would violate French sovereignty and international law.

stories.title: Apple launches legal challenge against UK government demand to access data
stories.summary: Apple is challenging a UK government demand for access to encrypted user data, in a case with implications for Home Office data-access and security powers.

stories.title: August bank holiday 2026 benefit payment date changes announced
stories.summary: DWP has confirmed changes to Universal Credit and other benefit payment dates around the August bank holiday, with most payments moving earlier where the scheduled date falls on the holiday.

stories.title: Defra creates board to monitor Waste Crime Action Plan progress
stories.summary: Defra has established a new oversight board to track progress on its Waste Crime Action Plan, which was launched in March 2026 to tackle illegal waste activity.

stories.title: Robot revolution hits the fields as £20 million funding announced
stories.summary: Defra has announced £20 million in funding to develop farm robots and automated systems capable of planting, tending and harvesting crops.

stories.title: The virtual gaming worlds transformed to train British soldiers
stories.summary: The MoD is using immersive gaming technology built by UK company Skyral, part of a consortium that won a £2bn contract to train the British Army, to prepare soldiers for combat.

agencies.name: DSIT
agencies.description: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology

stories.title: Dame Chi Onwurah questions the sense in closing DSIT
stories.summary: The government's decision to close the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology has raised concerns from Dame Chi Onwurah about fragmentation of vital digital and science functions across Whitehall.

stories.title: Sovereign AI invests in UK startup reinventing AI chips
stories.summary: The UK government's Sovereign AI fund has made an investment in a UK startup working on next-generation AI chip technology, part of efforts to boost domestic AI compute capacity.

stories.title: NHS radiographers report rise in overt racist abuse by patients
stories.summary: A survey by the Society of Radiographers found a noticeable rise in racist abuse of NHS staff by patients over the past 18 months, including staff being called racial slurs and patients refusing treatment from non-white staff.

stories.title: The best way to protect NHS patients' data
stories.summary: Commentary on how systems holding patients' most sensitive NHS data keep ending up concentrated with a small number of large suppliers, and what should be done about it.

stories.title: Royal Mail warns of service disruption across 77 postcode areas
stories.summary: Royal Mail issued a service update warning customers of delivery disruption across 77 postcode areas over the weekend of 1–2 August, with regular updates on affected offices.
